documents.text: The quay office counted 40 oil lanterns and 12 electric lanterns on 2 June 2026. The oil lanterns were tagged for repair. The ledger does not give their purchase price.
Kiln North fired 18 batches in May 2026. Kiln South fired 18 batches in June 2026. Neither log records the fuel type.
The sample used only plant dye. No mineral dye was added. The notebook lists the dyer as one person.
Lock Seven opened at 09:40. The notice says the lock closes at 17:00. It does not state the fee.
Plot A yielded 6 kilograms. Plot B yielded 9 kilograms. The trial did not report rainfall.
The west desk answers letters from 08:00 until 12:00. After 12:00 the desk files maps. The sheet lists no weekend hours.
On 4 April 2026 the ferry left at 07:10 because the gate was open. The log gives no passenger count.
The mosaic used 200 glass tiles and 50 stone tiles. The curator counted the tiles once.
